featured_reviews.name: Dr Rasika Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
I celebrated my Golden Retriever Joey’s first birthday, and I ordered his cake from Doggy Bakery — and I must say, it was a wonderful experience. The cake was delivered on time, beautifully designed, and looked absolutely amazing.
The most important part for me was that Joey has a very sensitive stomach, yet he had no stomach upset at all after eating the cake. In fact, the moment we finished singing for him, he immediately broke into the cake and started eating it on his own — no hesitation, no coaxing, nothing. He ate almost half the cake instantly, which itself says a lot!
The next day, both my Golden Retrievers, Joey and Bella, finished the remaining cake, and once again, no digestive issues whatsoever. They were perfectly fine, active, and clearly loved the taste — their expressions said it all. Because they enjoyed the cake so naturally, it truly made Joey’s birthday even more special.
I was so happy with the experience that I’ve already placed another order for my second pet Bella’s upcoming birthday — this time along with a pizza and pepper burger as well. Really looking forward to it!
As a small suggestion, it would be lovely if Doggy Bakery could also offer pet-specific birthday decorations, such as paw-print balloons or dog-themed inflatable balloons. That way, we could arrange the entire birthday celebration from one place without having to search elsewhere.
Overall, I absolutely loved the cake — it was beautiful, well-designed, and clearly pet-safe. This is a fantastic initiative, and I’m definitely looking forward to ordering many more things from Doggy Bakery in the future. Highly recommended! 🐶🎂💛

featured_reviews.name: Neha Mendon
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masa Bakery has quickly become a standout destination for those who appreciate the intersection of artisanal craft and a cozy, neighborhood vibe. Tucked away on Juhu Tara Road, it offers an escape from the Mumbai bustle with its minimalist, warm aesthetic and the undeniable aroma of fresh yeast and butter.
Masa specializes in small-batch baking, and the quality is evident in the textures of their breads and pastries.
Laminated Pastries: Their croissants are a masterclass in layering—shatteringly crisp on the outside with a soft, airy, honeycomb interior. The Almond Croissant is particularly noteworthy for its generous filling that isn't overly sweet.
The Sourdough: A staple for many regulars, their sourdough loaves have a robust crust and a perfectly developed tang. It serves as an excellent base for their various tartines and toasties.
Artisanal Bites: Beyond the classics, look for their seasonal danishes and savory puffs, which often feature creative flavor combinations like caramelized onion, goat cheese, or local seasonal fruits.
Coffee: They take their brews as seriously as their bakes. The coffee is consistently well-extracted, making it a reliable spot for a flat white or a pour-over to pair with your pastry.
Masa Bakery brings a slice of modern, high-end bakery culture to Juhu. While it sits at a slightly higher price point than your average local bakery, the attention to detail in their fermentation process and the quality of ingredients make it well worth the visit for any dedicated carb-connoisseur. Very quaintly located in Juhu with an Interesting Menu #Masa #Bakery #Juhu

featured_reviews.review_text:
I've heard so much about the wonders of The Boston Cupcakery. However, our enthusiasm to try out this place wasn't translated into a wonderful experience.

This small outlet is located within a dense commercial/residential area. You'd need a cab to get here because parking was a little difficult.

There isn't a lot of seating. Only one table is there in the AC area and another in the outside seating area. There isn't any music available and the lighting was really off. The lights kept flickering. We had to request that they be switched off.

We first went in for the 24-layer Pastry. This is a very good dessert. Even though there are so many layers of cream and cake, the dessert wasn't very heavy. It's great for sharing.

The next came the Red Velvet Pastry. There's no other way to describe it than just plain terrible. This is the worst version of this cake I have had so far. The cake looked a little slumped when it was served to us but we didn't think much about it. With one small slice, the entire pastry collapsed. The cake itself wasn't so good and the icing was very off. There were instances where we thought this might be a cheesecake but it wasn't. The cake had a room temperature which might indicate that the refrigeration of the desserts aren't up to the mark.

I'm not pleased with the variation in the quality of desserts. One was good while the other was terrible making it difficult for me to recommend this place.

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Bhagwati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Café – So I got hooked to this newly opened joint of Elementaria Café in Juhu. I am regular visitor of the brand in Matunga branch and love their offerings and overall spread of options. I was one of the first customers to this newly open joint and in terms of overall food and drinks quality I relished it.

Luckily we were 4 friends and we tried many things out there as below

•    Vietnamese cake icecream (If I recollect it right) (Rating 3/5) – Thought this would be really interesting given its description but was let down as the cake/pastry was hard even to cut it through spoon. Is it really supposed to be like this I doubt.

•    Hazelnut Red Velvet Tubcake (Rating 5/5) & Intense Chocolate Tubcake (Rating 5/5) – These were lovely little cakes with intense chocolate flavors. The cake around the chocolate liquid was decadent to satisfy with each bite. Loved both.

•    48 Layers Chocolate Cake (Rating 5/5) – This is the best dessert out there IMO! This 48 layer signature cake is so so good that you can actually get it for free if you end up finishing the same in less 10 mins. The entire cake takes about 2 days to make and it weighs roughly 13 pounds.

•    Choco Shake Rating (4/5) – Decent shake offered at their place! Similar to keventers but I think slightly better version imo!

•    Messy Melon icecream (Rating 5/5) – This is another signature item to have at their place. See the picture and you will know why its so sought after item to order. The lovely creation of water melon cut in intricate manner accompanied with delicious melon icecream is a winner! Must order out there.

•    Peri Peri Paneer Hotdog (Rating 4/5) & Chicken Tikka Sandwich (Rating 4/5) – Both offerings were great savory accompaniments with dessert choices they have out there. My personal fav was chicken tikka sandwich which comes with brown bread and generous amount of chicken tikka semi dry gravy. Paneer had unique spiciness but I felt salt somehow lacking in it! Maybe it was my bad day but liked it in general.

•    Marshmellow Hot Chocolate (Rating 5/5) & Hot Mocha with Marshmellow (Rating 5/5)  - Both were WOW! U cant go wrong with these choices usually and this place keeps up with the standards too. Hot chocolate was my personal fav which had the lovely texture of chocolate milk and thick enough to sip in fractions and enjoy till late evenings.

Overall the food and desserts were good, staff even though it was first day were able to manage our orders and others at a same time, the only downside in my opinion of this place is the ambience. It gets extremely uncomfortable to be there inspite of fans at almost each table. They should try adding cooler or something that can make sitting out there pleasant. Hope they can hence for now I rate them 4 for my overall experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for the feedback.  Glad to know you loved our food.  We are definitely trying to cool the place in some or the other way. Hopefully one way shall work out soon.  No way we would let our guests get troubled like that.
Love,
Team Elementaria.

featured_reviews.name: Prajwal Kather
featured_reviews.review_text: Totally worth the hype . We visited this cozy aesthetic cafe in versova and were totally in love with their wide range of desserts , savouries and beverages. Tried a bit of everything . Our personal favourite was the seasonal strawberry frappe and it tasted really fresh and yummy. The chicken cheese sandwich was delicious and filling and last but not the least tried their hot mocha with butter croissant which was straight out of our dreams . featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cherry N Chocolate is a cozy café offering a delightful mix of sweet and savory treats. We tried the Brownie Shake, which was rich, chocolatey, and perfectly blended. The Paneer Sandwich had a fresh, flavorful filling with well-toasted bread. The Chicken Croissant was buttery, flaky, and generously stuffed, making it a great snack.
Their Chocolate Mousse was smooth, indulgent, and melted in the mouth with every bite. The Strawberry Cooler was refreshing, with a balanced sweetness and tanginess that made it perfect for a hot day. The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a great spot to relax. Service was prompt and courteous, adding to the pleasant experience. The menu offers a variety of options, catering to both sweet cravings and savory bites. Pricing is reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. Overall, Cherry N Chocolate is a great place to enjoy delicious food and desserts!

featured_reviews.name: The Hogger Bloggers
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this newly opened Cafe in Versova and had a wonderful experience. Right from coffees to desserts to sandwiches, everything we had here was craveworthy. Taking you through a detailed review of what all we had here:

Spanish Brew Coffee (Recommended)

Light, airy and perfectly condensed hot latte which was absolutely refreshing.

Mocha Blended Frappe

A simple blended cold coffee with chocolate and whipped cream coming together for a mocha flavour that will leave you wanting for more. It's for those who like having their coffee sweet.

Chicken And Cheese Croissant Sandwich (Recommended)

Creamy chicken with cheese wrapped in croissant and loaded with flavour. Was really delicious and probably something we would love to order again next time.

Chicken Club Sandwich

Juicy grilled club sandwich loaded with chunky chicken, yummy veggies and creamy mayo. Full of texture and savoury.

Blueberry Cheesecake

Cream cheese mixed with blueberry sauce topping and layered on a buttery biscuit base. Rich filling and really yum.

Gooey Dark Chocolate Brownie

Square chocolate brownie filled with the goodness of gooey dark chocolate. Sugar tooth activated for this one.

This place has brilliant ambience with some fantastic coffee options and tempting desserts. Good place to meet your friends and they also have some books to read. Definitely visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: eat or regret
featured_reviews.review_text:
Versova has this beautiful Dessert Cafe called Cherry and Chocolate. I visited this cafe to have my breakfast today and let me tell you their Hot Chocolate, Fresh Desserts, Coffee and Breakfast Menu is totally worth trying.

They have a very classy ambience and literally a tree inside this cafe makes it unique.

And I would highly recommend you to try Dark Hot Chocolate and in Desserts this Crunchy Almond Cheesecake. We also tried Milkyway pastry which was fresh and soft sponge.

In sandwiches, must try is their Chicken Club Sandwich and Tandoori Paneer Sandwich. In coffee we tried Devil Chocolate Frappe.

If you are looking for a perfect breakfast date place then this is the place you can visit.

as a loyal customer, this has been enough for me to stop ordering altogether. sharing this so others are aware of the change.

very very disappointing.

The chicken cutlet was flavorful but a little too spicy and slightly dry for my liking. The chicken puff, however, was excellent. Overall, a must-visit bakery with great flavors.

featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sri Ganesh Iyengar Bakery and Fast Food offers a wide variety of cakes, similar to a typical Iyengar Bakery. In the same premises, there is also a fast-food corner where you can get items like dosa, samosa, pav bhaji, and other fast-food dishes. So overall, it’s a bakery-cum fast-food corner.

We tried their rava cake, and it was really nice. The cake was very soft and fresh. Compared to other Iyengar bakeries, their cakes felt noticeably softer and better in texture. Overall, it was a really great experience.

featured_reviews.name: Bibhor Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a good place for eating. South Indian food was very good here and service was prompt. Restaurant is small but location is good and is clean.

featured_reviews.name: Devashri V
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a usual here. I just love the simplicity of this place. You can get both healthy and not so healthy but tasty snack items at a very reasonable rate, no cutting corners. Just good food quick service and you can get back to your day. My favorites are vada pav, sada dosa, benne dosa paired with cold coffee or chai.. They dont add ice cream to cold coffee and thats how I like it. Open seating, sometimes sharing a table with a random stranger and having a conversation. Just good old simple things that are becoming rare in this city. I wish there were more places like these.

The restaurant is open air service that can become excessively hot due heat from the kitchen, immediate need to improve on the ventilation.
